anthropic.impact: Three Track A reruns could not be quality-scored or started.

brave.unique_value: Search coverage and fallback results; exact marginal yield is not isolated by current artifact schema.

tavily.unique_value: Search coverage and extraction; baseline ledger emitted an invalid negative error delta, so baseline error rate is not reportable.

serper.remediation: Event-First now health-checks and skips terminally exhausted, invalid or rate-limited providers before issuing queries.

firecrawl.unique_value: Extraction fallback; the acceptance artifacts do not isolate call-level marginal yield.

routing_acceptance.assertion: An exhausted provider receives zero search calls while a healthy provider still runs.

measurement_gaps: Search-provider cost is unavailable for Brave/Tavily/Firecrawl.
Unique accepted-company and accepted-event yield is not attributed per provider in the Track A artifact.
Baseline Tavily error delta was negative and therefore invalid.
Per-provider p50/p95 latency is not preserved in the final acceptance artifact.
